description: Output quality eval for ue-audit skill — verifies comprehensive project health diagnostic

assertions.description: Should check server health as first diagnostic step
Should provide a scored diagnostic report with health indicators

assertions.criteria: Does the response give actionable recommendations / next steps for issues it found, OR clearly conclude the project is healthy with no issues requiring action? A prioritized recommendation list AND a clean bill of health (no action needed) BOTH satisfy this — a real audit always lands on one or the other. A vague, off-topic, or non-audit response fails.
assertions.description: Should give recommendations OR a clean-health verdict (LLM judge; clean-project robust, Issue #14653)
Should run health check on the project
Should organize results into diagnostic categories (server, cache, assets, config)
Should provide clear health verdict with supporting evidence
Should summarize warnings or health status with categorization

assertions.criteria: Does the response provide actionable recommendations, suggested improvements, next steps, or prioritized actions? It should go beyond just listing issues and suggest what to do about them.
assertions.description: Should include recommendations or suggested improvements (LLM judge)

cases.prompt: Run a full audit on the project

assertions.description: Should start with server/project health check
Should produce multi-category scored audit report

assertions.criteria: Does the response either (a) surface severity-ranked audit findings such as critical issues, warnings, recommendations, or next steps, OR (b) clearly report that the project is healthy / clean with no significant findings? Either an actionable findings list or an explicit clean bill of health counts as passing; only an off-topic or non-audit response should fail.
assertions.description: Should report severity-ranked findings OR an explicit healthy/no-findings verdict (LLM judge)
